name: ibis budget Singapore Gold
short_description: A 44-room 2-star budget hotel on Sims Avenue in Geylang, built in 2022, within walking distance of Kallang and Aljunied MRT stations.
ai_summary: ibis budget Singapore Gold is a compact, purpose-built 2022 property at 123 Sims Avenue in Geylang, roughly a 9-12 minute walk from both Aljunied and Kallang MRT stations. The 44-room, 6-floor hotel offers Superior, Deluxe, and Quad room configurations from 12 to 25 square metres, with air conditioning, smart TVs, filtered drinking water, and 24-hour reception, but no pool, gym, or on-site restaurant. Guest and blog reviews consistently praise the compact, well-kept rooms, friendly staff, and easy MRT access, alongside Geylang's dense concentration of hawker food and halal dining options nearby. The hotel does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme's points or elite-tier benefits, though ALL members can still book member rates.

faqs.question: How far is ibis budget Singapore Gold from the nearest MRT station?
faqs.answer: It's about a 9-minute walk to Aljunied MRT Station and a 12-minute walk to Kallang MRT Station. It's also roughly a 4-minute drive to the Singapore Sports Hub and an 11-minute drive to the Central Business District.

faqs.question: When was ibis budget Singapore Gold built?
faqs.answer: The hotel was purpose-built in 2022, making it one of the newer ibis budget properties in Singapore. It's a compact 6-floor, 44-room hotel in the Geylang neighborhood, offering Superior, Deluxe, and Quad room configurations ranging from 12 to 25 square metres.

faqs.question: Can ALL - Accor Live Limitless members earn points at ibis budget Singapore Gold?
faqs.answer: No -- per the hotel's official ALL listing, this property does not participate in ALL points earning, redemption, or elite-tier benefits like room upgrades or lounge access. ALL members can still book member-exclusive rates when reserving directly through the ALL - Accor Live Limitless website or app.
